about_the_game:
SUCCESS LIES BETWEEN AN ACCURATE DIAGNOSIS AND THE NEXT APPOINTMENT TIME.

In Psychologist Life | The Daily Struggle, every day is a new challenge. This isn't just a therapy game; it's a real-life simulation that requires time management, strategy, and personal discipline. Every client who walks through your clinic door is not just a case, but a puzzle you must solve against your own schedule. To succeed, you must be as knowledgeable as an expert and as methodical as a strategist.

Game Features

  • Detailed Daily Routine Simulation: Start your day, brush your teeth, put on your work clothes from your closet, and head to your clinic. Every small task is part of preparing for the busy day ahead, immersing you in the atmosphere of this professional world.

  • Strategic Appointment & Time Management: Here, time is measured not by a stopwatch, but by the appointment calendar. While treating a patient, you must always keep an eye on the clock and the next appointment. For example, you must finish treating your 8:00 AM patient before your 12:00 PM patient arrives. Otherwise, the next client won't show up, and your task for the day will fail. Therefore, scheduling appointments and their intervals is entirely up to your strategy.

  • Diagnosis & Treatment at Your Computer: Knowledge is your most powerful weapon, and your entire arsenal is on your computer. Create your appointments, and develop yourself by reading resources about illnesses and treatment methods on your PC. The more you learn, the more accurate your diagnoses and the more efficient your treatments will be.

  • Specialization & Career Progression: Begin your career with the competence to treat 10 basic illnesses. Earn experience points (XP) from every successfully completed session. Accumulate these points to unlock the treatment for a total of 25 different illnesses and expand your area of expertise. It's in your hands to become the most sought-after psychologist for the toughest and rarest cases.

Can you manage time, increase your knowledge, and make the right decisions under pressure?

The clinic doors are opening, your patients are waiting, and the clock is ticking...

content_descriptors.notes:
This game addresses mature and sensitive topics through the dialogues between a psychologist and their patients. Themes explored include potentially distressing psychological subjects such as depression, anxiety, trauma, and suicidal ideation.

The game does not contain any visual violence, gore, or sexual content; all sensitive material is conveyed through text and dialogue.

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Can you heal a mind while racing against time? Psychologist Life is a strategic simulation game where you experience the life of a psychologist. Carefully plan your appointments, use your knowledge to treat patients, and prove your time management skills.
supported_languages: Turkish, English, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America
